description: This file contains unit tests for the PresentationMessageMap class, testing its behavior in handling localized messages within the OpenMRS messaging source module.

classes.name: PresentationMessageMapTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PresentationMessageMap, verifying locale filtering when adding messages.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a PresentationMessageMap instance with English locale before each test.

methods.name: put_shouldShouldIgnoreNonMatchingLocaleMessages
methods.description: Tests that the map ignores messages that are not from the specified locale when adding individually.

methods.name: putAll_shouldFilterOutNonMatchingLocaleMessagesFromBatchAdd
methods.description: Tests that batch addition of messages filters out messages with mismatched locales.
